description: Five children test which anaesthetics the neonatal question counts: a child aged exactly 28 days and a child aged 27 days at the start, each with readings below 40, a neonate whose charted pressure has no recorded mean, a neonate whose only low mean the source marks as not accepted, and a neonate with two anaesthetics on different days who died within 90 days of both.

expectations.says: The child is exactly 28 days old at the start, counted by calendar date although less than 28 whole days have passed since the hour of birth, so the query leaves the anaesthetic out.
expectations.query: SELECT a.age_days, COUNT(d.person_id) AS died_within_90_days FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id LEFT JOIN omop.death d ON d.person_id = a.person_id AND d.death_date >= CAST(a.start_datetime AS date) AND d.death_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, CAST(a.start_datetime AS date)) WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990003400' GROUP BY a.age_days

expectations.says: The readings below 40 of the child aged 28 days stand for exactly three minutes, which the query never counts.
expectations.query: WITH reading AS (SELECT a.anaesthetic_id, a.end_datetime, m.measurement_datetime, m.value_as_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.anaesthetic_id, m.measurement_datetime ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 21490852 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.measurement_id) AS kept_at_time FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.measurement_event_id = a.anaesthetic_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (21492241, 21490852) AND m.measurement_datetime >= a.start_datetime AND (a.end_datetime IS NULL OR m.measurement_datetime <= a.end_datetime) WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990003400'), stood AS (SELECT value_as_number, measurement_datetime, COALESCE(LEAD(measurement_datetime) OVER (ORDER BY measurement_datetime), end_datetime) AS until_datetime FROM reading WHERE kept_at_time = 1) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN value_as_number < 40 AND until_datetime IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(second, measurement_datetime, until_datetime) > 300 THEN 300 ELSE DATEDIFF(second, measurement_datetime, until_datetime) END ELSE 0 END), 0) / 60.0 AS minutes_below_40, COUNT(*) AS kept_readings FROM stood

expectations.says: The child is 27 days old at the start, so the query counts the anaesthetic.
expectations.query: SELECT a.age_days, COUNT(d.person_id) AS died_within_90_days FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id LEFT JOIN omop.death d ON d.person_id = a.person_id AND d.death_date >= CAST(a.start_datetime AS date) AND d.death_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, CAST(a.start_datetime AS date)) WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990003401' GROUP BY a.age_days

expectations.says: The charted pressure of the neonate without a mean gives a systolic and a diastolic row and no mean of any kind.
expectations.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id IN (3004249, 3012888) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charted, SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id IN (21492241, 21490852, 3027598) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS means FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = m.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990003402'

expectations.says: The mean of 35 that the source marks as not accepted is not written.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = m.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990003403' AND m.value_as_number = 35

cases: A child exactly 28 days old at the start by calendar date, with means below 40, should not be counted, because the child is not a neonate.
A child 27 days old at the start, whose arterial mean below 40 stands for three minutes, should be counted with 3 minutes below 40.
A neonate of 10 days whose charted pressure has no recorded mean should fall in the band for no mean pressure recorded.
A neonate of 10 days whose only mean below 40 the source marks as not accepted should give no minutes below 40.
A neonate with two anaesthetics, at 5 and 12 days, who died within 90 days of both, should give 3 and 5 minutes below 40 and count the death once for each anaesthetic.
